title: HSK2 Gate 18 · Yuan Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 18: Yuan Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第18关：元朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 七百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫元朝。那时候的大王叫忽必烈。他的国家非常大，从东边一直到很远的西边。因为路上比以前安全，所以来往的人多了。
passageEn: More than seven hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Yuan. Its great khan was called Kublai. His realm was vast, reaching from the east far into the west. Because the roads were safer than before, more people travelled.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than seven hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Yuan.
comprehension.answer: 七百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫元朝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: His realm was vast, reaching from the east far into the west.
comprehension.answer: 他的国家非常大，从东边一直到很远的西边。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Yuan Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说元朝。
